candidates.requirement: Exercise parser cleanup with an unattached saved comment after a parse error.
candidates.target_route: Construct the same parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS, parse the finite input `#x\n?`, and free the parser after the error.
candidates.failure_condition: The old entry constructs with flag 0, so it cannot save a comment; it also returns before ucl_parser_free when an error is reported. The new cleanup is never exercised.
candidates.alternative_paths: The single entry has no other constructor or cleanup call. Successful parsing with flag 0 cannot create last_comment.

candidates.requirement: Free the parser on the entry's parse-error path.
candidates.target_route: For the finite input `{`, the entry constructs a parser, calls ucl_parser_add_string, observes the unmatched-brace error, and returns.
candidates.failure_condition: The error branch returns without calling ucl_parser_free, leaving the allocated parser and its owned state unreleased.
candidates.alternative_paths: The entry's only ucl_parser_free call follows the error guard; no later cleanup runs on that branch.
